value.rationale: Two frequencies are the first nontrivial interference class of finite idempotents, so their exact point-concentration constant is a natural baseline rather than an arbitrary slice. The theorem gives a complete all-modulus/all-target classification, reveals a genuine quotient-divisor and target-gcd mechanism at composite moduli, and supplies the exact prime benchmark \(2\sin(\pi/(2p))\cos(\pi/p)=\pi/p+O(p^{-3})\).
